acceptanceCriteria: A .state() name or parent that is a member expression X.Y, where X is imported from a tracked file declaring Y as a string literal (export const X = {Y: '...'} object literal, or a string enum member), resolves to that literal with evidence anchored to the declaration.
Anything else (computed, reassigned, spread, untracked, ambiguous) stays UNKNOWN non-literal-name; nothing is guessed.
Maintained fixtures/tests cover object-literal, enum, re-export-free import and the UNKNOWN cases; AMAP spec updated.
